400.label: Bad request
400.title: Let’s start with a fresh page.
400.message: Something in this request didn’t look quite right. Head home and open the page again.

401.label: Authorization required
401.title: This door needs a little permission.
401.message: This page requires authorization. If you believe you should have access, please contact our community team.

402.label: Payment required
402.title: There’s a step to complete first.
402.message: This service requires a payment step before it can continue. Please contact the team for guidance.

403.label: Access restricted
403.title: A closed door. An open welcome.
403.message: This page isn’t available for public access. You’re always welcome to explore our community or get in touch.

404.label: Page not found
404.title: A little lost. Still part of the family.
404.message: The page you’re looking for may have moved, or the link may have taken a wrong turn. Let’s find your way home.

405.label: Method not allowed
405.title: Let’s take another way in.
405.message: This page can’t accept that kind of request. Return home and use the website’s links to continue.

406.label: Format unavailable
406.title: A different view may help.
406.message: We can’t provide this page in the requested format. Try opening it again from the homepage.

408.label: Request timed out
408.title: That took a little too long.
408.message: The request didn’t finish in time. Check your connection, then try the page again when you’re ready.

409.label: Request conflict
409.title: Let’s get back in step.
409.message: This request conflicts with the current state of the page. Refresh to get the latest version before continuing.

410.label: Page retired
410.title: This chapter has come to a close.
410.message: This page has been removed. There’s still plenty to discover in our community, celebrations and family activities.

411.label: Request length required
411.title: A small detail is missing.
411.message: This request is missing information needed to continue. Please return to the page and submit it again.

412.label: Precondition failed
412.title: Time for a fresh start.
412.message: The page has changed since this request began. Refresh it to continue with the latest version.

413.label: Request too large
413.title: A little less will go a long way.
413.message: This request is larger than the service can accept. Try a smaller file or a shorter submission.

414.label: Address too long
414.title: Let’s take the shorter route.
414.message: This web address is too long to open. Head home and follow a link to the page you need.

415.label: Unsupported format
415.title: Let’s try a different format.
415.message: The service can’t accept this file or content type. Check the requested format before trying again.

416.label: Range unavailable
416.title: Let’s open the whole picture.
416.message: The requested part of this file isn’t available. Open the original page or download again from the beginning.

417.label: Expectation failed
417.title: Let’s try a simpler approach.
417.message: The service couldn’t meet a requirement of this request. Return to the page and try again.

421.label: Misdirected request
421.title: This request took a wrong turn.
421.message: The request reached a service that can’t answer it. Please open the page again from our homepage.

422.label: Request couldn’t be processed
422.title: A little adjustment should help.
422.message: Some information in this request couldn’t be processed. Check your details and try submitting again.

423.label: Resource locked
423.title: This page needs a moment.
423.message: This resource is currently locked. Please give it a little time before returning.

424.label: Dependent service failed
424.title: One connection needs a moment.
424.message: A service needed for this request didn’t complete. Please try again in a little while.

425.label: Request too early
425.title: Just a little ahead of time.
425.message: This request arrived before it could be safely processed. Wait a moment before trying again.

426.label: Upgrade required
426.title: A newer connection is needed.
426.message: This service needs an updated connection protocol. Try opening the page in an up-to-date browser.

428.label: Precondition required
428.title: Let’s catch up with the page.
428.message: This request needs the latest page information before it can continue. Refresh and try again.

429.label: Too many requests
429.title: A small pause goes a long way.
429.message: There have been too many requests in a short time. Please wait a little before trying again.

431.label: Request headers too large
431.title: Let’s travel a little lighter.
431.message: The browser sent more request information than this service can accept. Try a private browser window or contact us if it continues.

451.label: Unavailable for legal reasons
451.title: This page isn’t available here.
451.message: Access to this content is restricted for legal reasons. Please contact the team if you need more information.

500.label: Something went wrong
500.title: A little hiccup. The welcome stays.
500.message: We couldn’t complete this request. Please try again in a moment, or return home to explore our community.

501.label: Not implemented
501.title: This path isn’t ready just yet.
501.message: This service doesn’t support the requested action. Head home to find what’s currently available.

502.label: Gateway error
502.title: A connection needs a little care.
502.message: A service we connect to returned an unexpected response. Please try again in a little while.

503.label: Temporarily unavailable
503.title: A short pause in the journey.
503.message: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please come back in a little while. Our community will be here to welcome you.

504.label: Gateway timeout
504.title: We’re waiting on a connection.
504.message: A service we connect to took too long to respond. Please give it a moment, then try again.

505.label: Protocol not supported
505.title: Let’s find a newer way through.
505.message: This service can’t use the requested connection version. Please try an up-to-date browser.

506.label: Server configuration error
506.title: A small tangle behind the scenes.
506.message: A service configuration issue stopped this request. Please return later, or let our team know if it continues.

507.label: Storage unavailable
507.title: A little room is needed.
507.message: The service doesn’t have enough storage to complete this request. Please try again later or contact the team.

508.label: Loop detected
508.title: Let’s step out of this circle.
508.message: The service encountered a loop while processing this request. Head home and try another path.

510.label: Extension required
510.title: One more piece is needed.
510.message: This service requires an extension to complete the request. Please contact the team for help.

511.label: Network sign-in required
511.title: Your network needs a hello first.
511.message: Your network may require you to sign in before browsing. Complete its sign-in page, then return here.

offline.label: Connection interrupted
offline.title: Offline for a moment. Connected in spirit.
offline.message: We can’t reach the website right now. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile connection, then try again.

client-error.label: Page interrupted
client-error.title: Let’s give this page a fresh start.
client-error.message: Something interrupted this page in your browser. Reload to try again, or head home for a fresh start.

maintenance.label: A little time to refresh
maintenance.title: Making room for what’s next.
maintenance.message: This page is taking a short maintenance break. Please visit again later, or contact our community team if you need us.
